summary: Umpqua NF tower built 1933 and staffed in 1937; sources disagree on its height and form; now gone, and no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.design: 20-foot round timber tower with an L-4 cab (Oregon Forest Lookouts); firelookout.com describes a 30-foot pole tower with a 12x12 ft cab
facts.status_note: Gone. Firelookout.com lists it as abandoned under its 1933 entry, with no other date; neither source gives a removal date.

staffing.status: a man spent two weeks at the lookout (last dated staffing)

events.note: Proposed in July 1932 as one of nine new lookouts, estimated at $5,300 for the nine
20-foot round timber tower with an L-4 cab (Oregon Forest Lookouts); 30-foot pole tower with a 12x12 ft cab (firelookout.com)
New panorama photographs taken in March 1934
Woodshed constructed at a cost of $28.00; another $13.20 spent in 1937
A man spent the previous two weeks at the lookout before returning to school (September 1937 report)

notes_for_editor: The brief's design (L-4) and height (6.1 m) follow the Oregon Forest Lookouts page, which gives a 20-foot round timber tower. Firelookout.com gives a 30-foot pole tower with a 12x12 ft cab and no L-4 mention. The story reports both and does not choose; the 6.1 m height rests on one source. Both sources date the build to 1933 and agree the site is gone; neither gives a removal date, so no removal event is recorded. Firelookout.com's 'Abandoned' sits under its 1933 entry and has no separate date. No source found describes the site today, and access is unknown, so no access or visit facts are recorded. The index line gives no FFLOS or NHLR number. No photos were found beyond the panorama photographs, which are cited by date only.
